# HodgeLociCI

> Macaulay2 package for Hodge loci (Noether-Lefschetz loci) of classes r[Y1] + s[Y2] of two linear or
> complete-intersection cycles in a smooth hypersurface of even dimension: a first-order excess calculator, a
> second-order obstruction check, and higher-order expansions at the Fermat point. AI-generated and not yet reviewed
> by a human; every result carries a label (EXACT, MOD p, PROVED in an unreviewed AI-written note, COMPUTED ONLY).
> Author: Timothy Seifert. Licence: MIT.

Requires Macaulay2 (tested with 1.22). Load with `needsPackage("HodgeLociCI", FileName => "M2/HodgeLociCI.m2")`.
Smoke test: `M2 --script examples/quickstart.m2` prints `RESULT <name> <value>` lines.

## Worked examples (captured sessions)

- [docs/01_excess_calculator.md](docs/01_excess_calculator.md): first-order excess, by degrees and at a point
- [docs/02_level_dichotomy.md](docs/02_level_dichotomy.md): the cases tau < 0 and tau >= 0
- [docs/03_second_order.md](docs/03_second_order.md): second-order obstruction on the excess directions
- [docs/04_fermat_certificate.md](docs/04_fermat_certificate.md): verifying an arc or obstruction certificate at the Fermat point
- [docs/05_tangent_codimension_two_determinants.md](docs/05_tangent_codimension_two_determinants.md): tangent codimension of a Hodge locus from an ideal
